ARCHITECTURE.md — Deployment Model & PWA Requirements
Purpose: how the game is built and shipped. Not for game rules (HANDOVER.md) or change history (HISTORY.md).

Deployment Model: PWA
* The multi-file source (index.html, style.css, pieces.css, script.js, pieces.svg, manifest.json, sw.js) is the primary deployment target and shipped form of the app.
* Piece art lives in pieces.css and pieces.svg, both generated by generate-piece-sprite.js from the light-*.svg files in the repo root; edit the generator, never either output.
* Include a web app manifest (manifest.json) and service worker (sw.js) that pre-caches all project files for offline play.
* Update the sw.js precache list whenever files are added, renamed, or removed.
* Served over HTTPS with no backend or build step required for deployment.

Optional Single-File Build ("Test Build")
* A single self-contained HTML file (jester-and-moat.html) may be compiled using the build.js script to concatenate index.html, style.css, pieces.css, the inlined piece sprite, and script.js only upon explicit request for quick local phone testing on Android over file:// via Acode.
* Keep the single-file build out of the primary PWA deployment path.
